name: comp-544
title: Image Cover Dropzone
blurb: Large dropzone with image preview filling the background.
description: Drag-and-drop upload area that displays selected image as full background when loaded. Shows upload instructions when empty; 5MB size limit.
use_when: Cover images, hero images, or full-width image selections.
avoid_when: Multiple file uploads; this is single-image only.
a11y: Drop area is keyboard accessible with tabindex -1. Input sr-only. Remove button clearly labeled.
